<h2 id="web2darksale">web2Darksale</h2>
<p>这个是一个原型链污染</p>
<p>我们发现购买的金额可以被改变</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3621557/202510/3621557-20251020214503606-2016225048.png" alt="image-20251019171944065" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3621557/202510/3621557-20251020214506196-886494175.png" alt="image-20251019172051705" loading="lazy"></p>

<p>然后发送得到flag</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3621557/202510/3621557-20251020214507609-92239183.png" alt="image-20251019172348727" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="misc1-checkin">misc1-checkin</h2>
<pre><code>oclz{loovyd_vb_l_bvnucd_hqpumj}
</code></pre>
<p>是反射密码</p>
<pre><code>x≡19y+25(mod26)
</code></pre>
<p>逐个处理字母（只转换字母）：</p>
<ul>
<li>o (14) → x=(19×14+25) mod 26=(266+25) mod 26=291 mod 26=5<em>x</em>=(19×14+25)mod26=(266+25)mod26=291mod26=5 → f</li>
<li>c (2) → 19×2+25=38+25=63 mod 26=1119×2+25=38+25=63mod26=11 → l</li>
<li>l (11) → 19×11+25=209+25=234 mod 26=019×11+25=209+25=234mod26=0 → a</li>
<li>z (25) → 19×25+25=475+25=500 mod 26=619×25+25=475+25=500mod26=6 → g</li>
</ul>
<pre><code>flag{affine_is_a_simple_crypto}
</code></pre>

<p>可以直接写了</p>
<pre><code>def decrypt(cipher):
    plain = []
    for i, c in enumerate(cipher):
        offset = i % 7 + 1
        if 'A' &lt;= c &lt;= 'Z':
            new_ord = ord(c) - offset
            if new_ord &lt; ord('A'):
                new_ord += 26
            plain.append(chr(new_ord))
        elif 'a' &lt;= c &lt;= 'z':
            new_ord = ord(c) - offset
            if new_ord &lt; ord('a'):
                new_ord += 26
            plain.append(chr(new_ord))
        elif c == '{':
            plain.append('}')
        elif c == '}':
            plain.append('{')
        else:
            plain.append(c)
    return ''.join(plain)

cipher = "AZFXK}qyuc_ge_ogwatxr_uhgzxpua_ktukKQErh{"
print(decrypt(cipher))
</code></pre>

</code></pre>
